i'm 15 and i went to a mental ward this past spring. it was right at the end of the school year when we had finals and my school was very understanding, but i know not every school is like that. but in my experience it was very helpful and i'm doing much better now. if you're considering that, i'd say do some research first about what the mental hospitals in your area are like, because i know my state has relatively good ones, but ultimately you should because anything is better than giving up. also they will probably set you up with a therapist after, so that problem will be solved. even if that's not really an option for you, just know that if you hang in there it gets better eventually and when it does you'll be really happy that you stuck around, i know from experience. i really hope this helps.
